summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #459, including both resolved thread-based comments and a new CodeRabbit issue comment that used a different format.
summary.outcome: All 10 previously resolved review threads confirmed clear; 6 of 7 new CodeRabbit issues fixed (1 marked not applicable) across auth.ts and oauth.rs, with both TypeScript and Rust compilation verified clean before pushing.

repo: CodeRabbit changed its review comment format — now posts a single issue comment instead of per-line review threads, so the GraphQL reviewThreads query won't surface its feedback.
The project uses fixed ports 14200-14202 for the OAuth local server (not dynamic/loopback ports).
cipher-box is a Tauri desktop app with a TypeScript frontend (auth.ts) and Rust backend (src-tauri/src/commands/oauth.rs).

code.finding: State validation must happen before cleanup() is called, otherwise a hang occurs on mismatched events.
JSDoc for the auth server documents fixed ports 14200-14202.
HTTP header parsing must loop-read until \r\n\r\n to handle headers split across TCP packets.
OsRng should be used instead of thread_rng() for nonce generation to guarantee CSPRNG semantics.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * must not be on the GET /callback response — it exposes the nonce to cross-origin pages; CORS header belongs only on the POST response.
The GET handler catch-all was serving the nonce page for any path; gated to /callback only.
OAuth popups were not being closed on timeout; fix added popup close call in timeout path.

workflow: When CodeRabbit posts as an issue comment rather than review threads, fetch it via the REST comments endpoint rather than the GraphQL reviewThreads API.
Reply to CodeRabbit issue comments via REST (gh api repos/.../issues/comments) using in_reply_to on the original comment ID.
Run both pnpm typecheck and cargo check before committing after cross-language (TS + Rust) changes.
The resolve-review-comments workflow uses GraphQL mutation resolveReviewThread for thread-based comments but requires a different approach for issue-comment-style reviews.

friction: CodeRabbit silently changed its review format from per-line review threads to a single issue comment, causing the standard GraphQL reviewThreads workflow to report 'no unresolved threads' even though there were 7 open issues.
The user had to manually notice and point out the format change by linking to the specific comment.
open_items: Issue #7 (close_oauth_popups iterates all window labels) was marked 'not applicable' as harmless but acknowledged — may be worth revisiting if label set grows.
No E2E tests were run despite OAuth flow changes; the transcript notes E2E should be run for E2E-relevant changes.
